audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Urgot all seven rows and difficulty was listed 8.5/10, contradicting a 54.77% Kayle win rate over 451 games and the packet chart (Urgot, Urgot, then Kayle x5).
audit.why: Urgot is a point-blank lane bully with no dash; Kayle's ranged Divine Ascent form plus R invulnerability flips the lane from level 3-6 onward.
audit.corrected: Urgot levels 1-2; Kayle levels 3 through 2+ items. Difficulty 5/10, Urgot carry threat 6/10.

audit.why: Spikes were already accurate: Urgot levels 1-3 and 4-5 Disdain window; Kayle level 6 and Nashor's Tooth first item.
audit.corrected: Kept four spikes; sharpened phase whys to name the real spike drivers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown text said 'track Disdain' everywhere without ever giving the number, and dontsFull[1].d described burning your own cooldown rather than Urgot's flip.
audit.why: Disdain (E) is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and is Urgot's only gap-closer; Purge (W) is 490 range and self-slows him, so range is the whole answer. Kayle's R grants untargetability that voids the Fear Beyond Death execute reel.
audit.corrected: Stated Disdain's 16s rank-1 cooldown, Purge's 490 range, and R invulnerability blanking the R execute.

audit.why: Disdain down for 16s at rank 1 is the trade window; Kayle's W heal is a flat 15s and a flip while it is down is the death pattern.
audit.corrected: Both numbers now appear in the Levels 4-5 and Level 3 rows.

edits.before: His W shreds you — survive his early, scale late. Kayle wins the Disdain cooldown windows.
edits.after: Purge shreds you point-blank — survive to 6, then kite. Disdain (14s) is his only gap-closer.

edits.after: Purge shreds you point-blank — survive, then kite.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Urgot's Disdain is down.
edits.after: Purge out-trades you at 490 range — last-hit at max range and step up only when Disdain is down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Urgot must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online — W heal and Q's resist shred stabilize you. Trade only when Disdain is down; it is 16s at rank 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Disdain's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Trade around Disdain's 16s cooldown and bank small leads. A flip while your 15s W heal is down still kills you — hold it for the flip.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Urgot's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Judgment's invulnerability blanks Fear Beyond Death's execute — pop it as he reels you, ride the window untargetable, then kite him.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Disdain's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's Tooth plus E's missing-health on-hit out-DPS him — no dash means he never closes.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Urgot carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: full ranged AoE power. Urgot is immobile and finite-scaling — kite him and close the game on your terms.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Disdain and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by how well you survive Disdain pre-6 and how hard you kite after.

edits.before: Carry threat: 8.5/10. If Urgot gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.
edits.after: Carry threat: 6/10. If Urgot gets ahead early, shift from trading to wave control, vision, and jungle play until 6.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — build your teamfight around that. Urgot carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — build your teamfight around that. Urgot carry threat: 6/10 — he has no dash, so kite him and he never reaches you.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Urgot carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Purge is 490 range and hits hardest point-blank — fight from max range.

notes: Level chart was fully inverted against the packet chart and a 54.77% win rate; fixed as matched full/content pairs. Kayle ability names in currentText (Radiant Blast, Celestial Blessing, Starfire Spellblade, Divine Judgment, Divine Ascent) match Riot data — left alone. Kayle's kit has no hard CC, but report[10].t claims 'Your CC / setup is premium gank assistance' — Q slow only; flagged rather than rewritten because it is boilerplate shared across matchups.
